teaching.c2d: Coaching sessions to prepare a concert, an audition or a new role. Focused work on stage presence and performance nerves.
teaching.c3d: Themed lessons on breathing and vocal support. The fundamentals of a healthy, well-projected voice.
teaching.c4d: Interpretation modules, solo or in duo. In-depth exploration of text, musicality and emotion.
teaching.c5d: Guidance and support for auditions and competitions. Mental preparation strategies and presentation technique.
teaching.m1d: Immersion in the French lyric repertoire of Massenet, Gounod and Bizet. Stylistic analysis and interpretative technique.
teaching.m2d: Exploring the great bel canto and verismo roles. Work on vocal line, ornamentation and dramatic expression.
teaching.m3d: A spiritual approach to oratorios, masses and requiems. Balancing technical virtuosity with emotional depth.
teaching.m4d: Refining stage presence and operatic acting. Movement, gesture and use of the stage.
teaching.a1d: An introduction to lyric singing for beginners. Discovering the voice, the basics of vocal technique and the pleasure of singing.
teaching.a2d: Collective practice of ensemble singing and operatic duets. Developing listening and group musicality.
teaching.a3d: Building an opera or oratorio role from end to end: libretto analysis, musical coaching and staging.
teaching.a4d: The art of the recital and the French mélodie. Diction, musical poetry and connecting with an audience.

pro.title: Press & presenters
pro.intro: For presenters, organisers and journalists: everything you need to introduce or engage Marie-Émeraude Alcime.
pro.bioShort: Marie-Émeraude Alcime is a mezzo-soprano from Guadeloupe. A permanent member of the Chorus of the Opéra-Théâtre de l’Eurométropole de Metz since 2016, she holds a master’s degree in musicology and won the 2017 Prix Talent d’Outre-Mer (CASODOM). She performs in opera, oratorio and recital, and is also a choir conductor and singing teacher.
pro.bioMedium:
Marie-Émeraude Alcime is a mezzo-soprano from Guadeloupe. Born into a family of musicians, she studied musicology and stage professions in Rouen and Nancy, up to a master’s degree. Since 2016 she has been a permanent member of the Chorus of the Opéra-Théâtre de l’Eurométropole de Metz.

On stage, she has sung the Mother in Offenbach’s Les Contes d’Hoffmann in Metz, where Ôlyrix praised her “sumptuous and generous voice”, and Madame de Quimper-Karadec in La Vie parisienne, in Metz and at the Opéra de Massy. She has worked under conductors José Miguel Pérez-Sierra, Claude Schnitzler and Aurélien Azan Zielinski, and with stage directors Jérôme Savary and Paul-Émile Fourny.

In recital she explores the German lied, from Wagner’s Wesendonck-Lieder to Mahler’s Kindertotenlieder. Winner of the 2017 Prix Talent d’Outre-Mer (CASODOM), she is also a choir conductor and singing teacher.
